title: Every Interview Session Now Leaves a Paper Trail | vitalii.no
description:
How a live AI interview tool went from "debug by memory" to a full, replayable paper trail for every session, stored in Cloudflare D1.

When a live translation or answer came out wrong there was no record of what the recognizer actually heard, what the rough machine draft said before the AI pass cleaned it up, or how long each step took. Debugging a bad session meant trusting memory of something that had already ended.

The app now logs every interim hypothesis, every final transcript, the rough draft, the translation pass, and every question-and-answer pair, buffering locally before sending it on. Queued events survive a dropped connection — they wait on the device and send themselves once the connection is back, with a sequence number so retries never duplicate an entry.

Every event syncs to the cloud every 3 seconds, so a session that went wrong can now be replayed exactly, instead of reconstructed from memory.
